query:
SELECT ms.slug, ms.name, mc.cardType, COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN mc.imageUrl LIKE '%CBH-%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ai_images,
  SUM(CASE WHEN mc.imageUrl LIKE '%-front%' OR mc.imageUrl LIKE '%-back%' OR mc.imageUrl LIKE '%mintcomic%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as card_photos,
  SUM(CASE WHEN mc.imageUrl IS NULL OR mc.imageUrl = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as no_image
FROM marvel_cards mc 
JOIN marvel_sets ms ON mc.setId = ms.id 
GROUP BY ms.slug, ms.name, mc.cardType
ORDER BY ms.id, mc.cardType
LIMIT 60;
